warning: These are twelve fictional entries, chosen so the offline matcher has something to match. This is NOT the OFAC SDN list and is not derived from it; no screening result against it says anything about any real person or entity. Point OXBOW_WATCHLIST_PATH at a published SDN.CSV download to screen for real.
replacement_procedure: Download SDN.CSV from the publishing authority's site out of band, place it at data/watchlist/sdn.csv, set OXBOW_WATCHLIST_PATH to that file and restart the API and worker. The version reported on every hit is derived from the file's record count and mtime, so a stale snapshot is visible in the response rather than assumed.
